description.p: Certified, artisanal, vibe-coded slop: an AI wrote all of it while a person said "yeah, looks good" and pressed Enter a lot.

cmx (pronounced "see-mix") is a minimal comic reader for .cbz files. It shows one page at a time, or two side by side, fit to the window, with nothing drawn over the image. It has no library: it opens whatever file it is given and remembers where you stopped reading.
